body:
PRE-EDIT estimand ruling requested on reviewer finding msg-01M1DD3AY28KVRTXKZR9NNCF39 before the P0 successor freezes.

Measured source conflict:
- DefaultLocalCostModel prices Propositional at 0.5 unless both predicates exist, and Entity at 0.5 when the recall has no specified participant.
- Both enter "always", so they enter terms, eligible, measured, support, and the blended total.
- AlignWire explicitly states these two neutral fallbacks mean the dimension is ineligible, not an unanswered measurement.

A one-line eligibility subtraction is not coherent. Current wire validation requires terms subsetOf eligible, and current blend prices every term before scaling against eligible weight. Leaving 0.5 in terms while excluding it from eligibility can make present weight exceed eligible weight and puts a priced regularizer outside the declared denominator.

Please rule the intended estimand:
A. the 0.5 values are explicit regularizer/prior prices, not measurements: authorize separating priced regularizer terms from measured/eligible evidence in CostBreakdown, blend, wire, and the existing authorized courts; or
B. the dimensions are ineligible and contribute no price: omit Propositional unless both predicates exist and omit Entity unless the recall has specified participants, with behavior/golden changes acknowledged; or
C. overrule the wire contract and declare the 0.5 values genuine measurements, with the scientific basis stated.

I recommend A only if the regularizer remains separately attributable and outside support scaling; otherwise B is the honest smaller model. I will not encode a default license by choosing. Existing paths cost.scala, wire.scala, CostSuite.scala, WireSuite.scala, Laws.scala, and the v4 golden/codec courts are already authorized and reserved; no new path is requested unless your chosen option requires one. HsmmResult sealing is complete and separately evidenced on the bead.
